Bill.BriefDescription: Providing for the sales of wine and beer at the legislative gift center.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to sales of wine and beer at the legislative giftcenter; adding new sections to chapter 44.73 RCW; and adding a newsection to chapter 66.12 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The legislature finds that the production ofwine grapes and hops in the state are important segments of Washingtonagriculture as evidenced by the continued investments made by the stateand local governments in developing the wine and beer industries,including the creation of viticulture and enology programs atWashington State University. The legislature further finds that thepromotion and sale of Washington wine and beer at the legislative giftcenter is harmonious with the purpose of the gift center, which is topromote the state and the goods produced around the state. Therefore,the legislature intends to allow the legislative gift center to sellwine and beer produced in Washington to visitors of legal drinking age.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 66.12 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Nothing in this title shall apply to or prevent the legislative p. 1 SB 5158gift center created in chapter 44.73 RCW from selling at retail foroffpremises consumption wine and beer produced in Washington by alicensed domestic winery or brewery.

The legislative gift center is authorized tosell at retail for offpremises consumption wine and beer produced inWashington by a licensed domestic winery or brewery. Wine and beersold by the legislative gift center must: (1) Be sold to individualstwentyone years of age or older; (2) be sold for personal use and notfor resale; and (3) have been purchased from a licensed beer or winedistributor or from a manufacturer authorized to distribute wine orbeer of its own production. The legislative gift center must collect and remit to thedepartment of revenue all applicable state and local taxes on sales ofwine and beer.
Sections 1 and 3 of this act are each addedto chapter 44.73 RCW.
